about: Faults planted in variants/faulty. variants/corrected is the same app with these three fixes and nothing else (see variants.diff). The checks are identical for both.

faults.title: Confirmed shown without a receipt
faults.what: When the receipt request fails, the app falls back to the transaction lookup and treats a known transaction as confirmed, although it is still waiting in the mempool.

faults.title: Admin function open to everyone
faults.what: setAllowlisted lacks onlyAdmin. The interface hides the control, the contract does not refuse it.

faults.title: Retry pays a second time
faults.what: After status unknown, the retry button sends a new payment instead of checking the first one, which is still pending.
